title: Project for Online Application for Passports through Sri Lanka Missions/Posts Abroad
decision_details: - A proposal has been submitted to the International Organization for Migration (IOM) for obtaining support to conduct passport applications process made by Sri Lankans through Sri Lankan Missions Abroad/ Posts abroad online in order to expedite the said process. Accordingly, the International Organization for Migration has agreed to provide funds for implementing a project to supply biometric capture centers and related equipment covering 20 Missions/Posts Abroad, and to develop systems/software to facilitate and integrate online connectivity with the Department of Immigration and Emigration and provide necessary technical support. The implementation of this project aims to facilitate overseas Sri Lankans to obtain passports quickly and easily using digital technology. Accordingly, the joint proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism and the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to implement the project for passport applications through online via 20 identified Sri Lanka Missions/Posts Abroad from this year, was approved by the Cabinet.
